testOutput:
Success! Completed the UI/UX audit on the demo account across dashboard, jobs list/detail, clients list/detail, quotes list/detail, and invoices list/detail at 1280px. Each page loaded with real data and the core views rendered as expected: jobs and invoices were populated, quote and invoice details showed line items/totals/GST, and client/job detail pages opened successfully. I also observed the authenticated app shell, sidebar navigation, and key actions like opening rows/details working normally.
Verification gaps:
I did not perform screenshot capture in a separate tool step because the provided environment already supplies screenshots after each action. Some transient overlays ('What You Missed') appeared during navigation but were dismissed or bypassed and did not block the audit.

Minor issues:
Observed browser console/page errors during the session: a failed resource load (net::ERR_FAILED), a WebSocket handshake failure to the Vite dev socket (HTTP 400), and a 404 on an active business-template endpoint while loading invoice detail. These did not prevent the audited pages from rendering, but they are worth reviewing.
